Your account shows that your next payment of $29 is due on the 17th.

Once cancelled, your access will end immediately.
Based on our policy, cancellations made before the end of a billing period are considered early cancellations, and partial refunds are issued in that case.
It's also worth knowing that failed two-factor authentication codes do not count as failed login attempts, so if you use 2FA, incorrect codes did not contribute to the lockout.
Password reset links expire after 30 minutes for security reasons, so as the email arrived yesterday, the link would no longer be valid by the time you clicked it today.
The billing date stays consistent and does not move around from month to month, even in months that have fewer days.
Please note that no partial refunds are issued for early cancellation, because the unused time is covered by the access you keep.
